description: This file defines the TimesheetPeriodService class, which provides methods to manage and retrieve timesheet period configurations, generate timesheet periods based on XML configuration, and interact with configuration services in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing timesheet period configurations, including retrieving, setting, and calculating the current timesheet period based on XML configuration.

methods.name: getDefinedTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the defined timesheet period for a given current date by parsing configuration XML and calculating the days.

methods.name: getDaysOfTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Creates a TimesheetPeriod object based on XML class name and calculates the days within the timesheet period for a specified date.

methods.name: isTimesheetPeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks whether the timesheet period has been defined via configuration.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Sets the start day for the timesheet period and updates configuration with the new XML.

methods.name: getTimesheetHeading
methods.description: Retrieves the heading/title for the timesheet period from the configuration XML.

methods.name: getTimesheetStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the timesheet period from the configuration XML.
